date_assessment.assessment: January 1, 2007 selects deaths or disabilities for military-service survivor benefits; fiscal years 2004 and 2005 select annuity calculations under PFEA. Annual January 1 cost-of-living adjustments and April 1 distribution deadlines are recurring schedules. IRC 1986, HEART Act 2008 and PFEA 2004 are reference names, not commencement dates of complete current wording. Preserve the explicitly labelled original retrieval-day record start separately from the source check.
date_assessment.title: Section 45-37A-51.09 Compensation Limits; Forfeitures; Required Minimum Distributions; Direct Rollovers.
quotes: (a) Compensation in excess of one hundred sixty thousand dollars ($160,000), or such other amount provided in the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, shall be disregarded. Such amount shall be adjusted for increases in the cost-of-living in accordance with Section 401(a)(17)(B), except that the dollar increase in effect on January 1 of any calendar year shall be effective for the fiscal years beginning with or within such calendar year. If compensation for any prior determination period is taken into account in determining a participant member’s benefits for the current fiscal year, the compensation for such prior determination period is subject to the applicable annual compensation limit in effect for that prior period.
